item.title: Plan
item.description: Plan # The budget shows one month at a time: what you planned, what you spent, what is left. The Plan view shows the same budget as a spreadsheet across several months — every envelope, category and tag is a row, every month is a column — so you can put next spring's holiday or an annual insurance premium into the plan long before the money moves. item.title: Currencies
item.description: Currencies # Settings → Currencies controls which currencies Econumo offers you when you create an account, a budget, or a budget element. It holds two kinds of currency: Econumo currencies — the ones that ship with your server. They are available to everyone on the instance, and their exchange rates are managed centrally and refresh automatically when the server has rate updates configured. My currencies — currencies you add yourself.

item.title: Recurring Transactions
item.description: Recurring Transactions # Rent, salary, subscriptions, an annual insurance premium — payments that repeat on a schedule don't need re-typing every time. Set them up once in Settings → Recurring transactions, and Econumo keeps track of when each one is next due. Econumo never posts anything behind your back. item.title: Multi-Currency
item.description: Multi-Currency # Econumo lets you keep accounts in different currencies and still budget across all of them. Each account has one fixed currency; transfers between currencies record both amounts, and your budget converts everything to a single currency so the totals add up. item.title: Accounts
item.description: Accounts # This section covers the basics of 'Accounts' in Econumo. Accounts represent your accounts in financial institutions — for example, "Savings account" or "Cash". Each account has its own currency, and accounts are grouped into folders (such as "Personal" and "Family") that structure the sidebar and the mobile home screen. item.title: Budgets
item.description: Budgets # This section introduces the basics of 'Budgets' in Econumo. Budgets enable you to implement a "Cash Stuffing" method, also known as the envelope budgeting approach, which uses envelopes to manage spending. item.title: Classifications
item.description: Classifications # This section introduces the basics of 'Classifications' in Econumo, including Categories, Tags, and Payees. All three entities share similar functionality: Create a new item. Update or delete an existing item. Merge a duplicate into another item. Archive or unarchive any item. Categories answer "what kind of spending is this?" — they're optional on a transaction, but picking one is what makes a budget useful. Tags cut across categories
